brief_summary: XW003 is an acylated human glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) analogue and is being developed for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity management.
brief_title: Effects of XW003 Versus Liraglutide on Body Weight of Adult Participants With Obesity

lead_sponsor.name: Sciwind Biosciences APAC CO Pty. Ltd.

official_title: A Phase 2, Open-label, Randomised, Dose-Finding Study of XW003, Once-Weekly Human Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Analogue, Compared With Once-Daily Liraglutide 3 mg in Adult Participants With Obesity

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage change in participants body weight (%) from the Baseline
